decisions.rationale: DJ Abigail and Abigail share the same country (UK) and appear at the same event on the same date, with a DJ prefix on one side.
Adel & Hanna (teacher) and Adel Dasalsa (DJ) share only the first name and France at one event; the 'Dasalsa' token matches the festival name, so the surname is not reliable.
Adelaide and Adelaide Carvalho share event, date, role and Portugal, but their listed styles conflict (Salsa/Bachata vs LadyStyling/AfroHouse).
Adilson Maíza & Telma shares the partner Telma and the Angolan country with Adilson & Telma, and the Adilson Maíza name is spelled the same on the solo entries.
Adrian & Marina and Adrian & Ruxi are two couples with different partners; the only shared evidence is the common first name Adrian and Romania.
Fajul & Agnes and Vassil & Agnes are different couples with different partners; the only shared evidence is the common first name Agnes and Germany.
Solo Agnes entries are Swedish and Fajul & Agnes lists Sweden only in a combined country field; a common first name plus a partial country overlap does not settle it.
Akram & Sara and Akram & Sarah are the same couple with a one-letter spelling variant of the partner name, and both list Switzerland.
Akram Bouchiba & Sara Paxolieta shares the partner Sara and Swiss country with Akram & Sara, and the Akram name is distinctive.
Akram & Sarah (Netherlands-Switzerland) matches Akram Bouchiba (Netherlands-Switzerland) with partner Sara Paxolieta, the same couple with a spelling variant of the partner name.
Ronald & Alba and Victor & Alba are two couples with different partners; the only shared evidence is the common first name Alba and Spain.
DJ Al”ben and Alben share the same name (with a stray quote mark), the same country (Bulgaria) and the same event on the same date.
ALBIR (teacher, Spain) and Albir Rojas (teacher, Spain) share the distinctive first name and country, and the full name extends the same stage name.
Aldo & Ale Chen extends the couple Aldo & Ale, sharing partner Aldo and the Netherlands country.
Solo Aleksandra (Poland) and Claudio & Aleksandra (Poland flag) share only the common first name and a Polish country flag; no partner or style evidence links them.
Aleksandra and Alessandra have different spellings, different partners and different stated countries (Poland vs Italy).
Marc & Alessandra (Italy) and Alessandra Sillano (Italy) share the first name and country, but the A side has no style and the B side has no partner to compare.
Alessio & Angelica and Alessio & Natalia are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Alessio and Italy match.
Alex & Delphine and Alex & Maylie are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Alex and France match.
Alex Malembe & Maylie shares the partner Maylie and the French country with Alex & Maylie.
Alex & Ornella and the generic DJ Alex share only the common first name; one DJ Alex entry matches Spain but the name appears across four unrelated events.
Alex Alberola (Spain, Bachata) matches the Spanish, Bachata-styled teacher Alex in Alex & Ornella, sharing country and style with a distinctive surname.
Alex Grafiada and Alex & Ornella share only the common first name and Spain; the B side lists no style to confirm a match.
Alex Salserito & Tiphaine shares the partner Tiphaine and the French country with Alex & Tiphaine, and a DJ Alex Salserito is listed at the same Center Parcs event.
The generic DJ Alex appears at four unrelated events, and only one entry matches Spain and Bachata with Alex Alberola; that is not enough to join a common name.
Alex Grafiada shares only the first name and Spain with one generic DJ Alex entry, and the B side lists no style to confirm.
Sacha & Alyssa and Chamalo & Jalyssa have different partners, and Alyssa/Jalyssa is a spelling variant that could be a typo or a different person.
King & Amélie and the solo Amélie share the exact name and Italy, but there is no partner or style on the solo side to confirm the link.
Ledou Kingsman & Amina and Mamadou & Amina are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Amina and Sweden match.
Solo Amina (Sweden) and Ledou Kingsman & Amina share only the common first name and Sweden.
Solo Amina (Sweden) and Mamadou & Amina share only the common first name and Sweden.
DJ Amine and Amine are both UK-flagged and appear at the same event on the same date, with a DJ prefix on one side.
Ben & Ana and Ana & Guilherme are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Ana and Portugal match.
Ben & Ana and Ana & Gui Zamora are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Ana match.
Ben & Ana and Pedro & Ana are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Ana match.
Ben & Ana and Ana Saavedra share only the common first name and Portugal; no partner or event overlap confirms the link.
Ana & Guilherme (Cuba/Portugal) and Ana & Gui Zamora (Cuba/Portugal) are the same couple at consecutive editions of one festival, with Gui as a short form of Guilherme.
Ana & Guilherme and Pedro & Ana are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Ana match.
Ana & Guilherme and Ana Saavedra share only the common first name and Portugal; no partner or event overlap confirms the link.
Ana & Gui Zamora and Pedro & Ana are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Ana match.
Ana & Gui Zamora and Ana Saavedra share only the common first name and Portugal; no partner or event overlap confirms the link.
Pedro & Ana and Ana Saavedra share only the common first name and Portugal; no partner or event overlap confirms the link.
Ana Maria & Stéphane shares the partner Stephane (accent variant) and Romania with Stephane & Ana; the accent-only difference is a spelling variant.
Stephane Lyke & Ana Maria Stoica shares the partner Stephane and Romania with Stephane & Ana, and the Ana Maria name matches.
Flowly & Anastasia and Flowly & Anastasiia share the partner Flowly and the Ukrainian spelling variant of the name.
Richard & Anastasia and Selim & Anastasia are different couples with different partners; only the common name Anastasia match.
Richard & Anastasia and Flowly & Anastasiia are different couples with different partners; the spelling variant does not overcome the partner mismatch.
Selim & Anastasia and Flowly & Anastasiia are different couples with different partners; the spelling variant does not overcome the partner mismatch.
Alfredo & Andrea and Luis & Andrea are different couples with different partners; only the common first name Andrea and Spain match.
Alfredo & Andrea and Pablo & Andrea appear at the same Quijano event on the same date with different partners, so they are two different couples.
